{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are working to help Americans cover housing-related costs, like utilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Families are already saving thousands of dollars with clean energy tax credits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"23 million households received free or monthly discounts, saving $30 to $75 per month on high-speed broadband through the largest internet affordability program in history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The internet affordability program expired in May because Republicans refused to act.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep fighting to reinstate the internet affordability program.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep working to expand other programs that reduce home heating, cooling, and water bills, especially in rural areas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Speeding the transition to cheaper renewable energy, like solar, will lower people's bills long-term.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is leading one of America's most ambitious efforts to prevent homelessness.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration's effort to prevent homelessness is based on a \"housing first\" principle.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is helping states and cities prioritize housing as the foundational step in delivering support, services, and jobs to rebuild lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration will work with Congress and local jurisdictions to increase supportive and interim housing options.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration will work with Congress and local jurisdictions to increase the services necessary to help unhoused individuals stay permanently housed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
